intro.fr: The Farmer Was Replaced se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: The Farmer Was Replaced can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Timon Herzog sort The Farmer Was Replaced en 2025.
text.en: Timon Herzog releases The Farmer Was Replaced in 2025.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub seadoggie001/TFWR-APMod, qui héberge l'APWorld de The Farmer Was Replaced.
text.en: The GitHub repository seadoggie001/TFWR-APMod, home of the The Farmer Was Replaced APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.0.1-beta (préversion).
text.en: The first version, v0.0.1-beta (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.0.10-beta, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (10 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.0.10-beta is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (10 versions released).

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, The Farmer Was Replaced rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, The Farmer Was Replaced joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
